defect.observed: Browser CI rendered four locator cards with only two unique locator IDs.
cause: recovery-now-v1 render calls could overlap across async fetch boundaries without a single-winner generation fence.
The served Pages deployment lagged/cancelled under concurrent gh-pages pushes, so browser CI could still execute the pre-repair module even after the branch blob was repaired.

behavior: Validate locator IDs and entry refs.
Collapse exact duplicate locator/ref rows deterministically.
Fence overlapping async renders with renderGeneration so only the newest render can insert.
Load recovery-now-v1.js through a versioned asset URL and verify served asset identity in the Chromium CI.

browser_verification.detail: The rerun passed the bounded locator fixture and progressed beyond the browser locator uniqueness assertion; the next terminal error was at the later durable activity-board Work Unit locator, where two matching cards were found.
